id.description: Unique slug; must match the filename (<id>.json).

name.description: Short display name, uppercase (e.g. NEURIPS, CHI).

year.description: Edition year of the conference itself (not the deadline year).

field.description: Research field tag, uppercase (e.g. VISION, NLP, SYSTEMS).

deadline.description: Paper submission deadline, ISO date (AoE assumed).

weight.description: Relative prominence; drives tile area in the heatmap. Rough guide: top-tier flagship 18-22, major 10-16, strong specialized 5-9, niche 1-4.

featured.description: Featured conferences render as accent-filled (inverted) tiles. Reserved for flagship venues; keep to roughly 1 in 4 entries.
